method.instrument: build-time-restored codec phase counters plus Lynx profileMark; no authored runtime source changes
method.createBoundary: programmatic BTS setRows start to transport commit ACK return
method.readinessBoundary: every real-path page completes seven timed-out runOnMainThread clock echoes before operation profiles are reset and create timing starts; the first echo also proves first-tree calls are open
method.clockResolution: integer Date.now milliseconds, calibrated per page across BTS and MTS with seven round trips; the minimum-RTT sample supplies offset and half-RTT uncertainty
method.realPathGate: range-bearing table must use mount-template-run descriptor fallback
method.scalarPathGate: separate range-free scalar replacement must use mount-program-run
method.countArm: deep prepare/restore/alias visits are mechanism evidence only and never timing evidence
method.profileOverhead: unprofiled app-driver control versus profile-disabled timeline versus full timed profile, alternating order at create@1k
method.validationControl: checked versus trusted, alternating order at 1k/2k/3k/5k

floors.papi: detached page; setup outside timer; 7 host nodes per row; public Element PAPI loops
floors.echo: ContextProxy round trip carrying one string sized to the 1k production commit
floors.vm: same fixed integer loop in BTS and MTS plus Node V8 host control
